termsBody: By creating an account on RentaMovil you authorize the processing of your personal data (first name, last name, email, phone and username) in accordance with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 (Habeas Data).

Your data will not be shared with third parties except where legally required or to complete the contracted service (e.g. payment processing).
Vehicle rental conditions will be presented and accepted again during the reservation process.
